approved: Build verified components only, "Verified components: a waitlist": the library doesn't cover this use case yet, so it is not built. You get a waitlist — working and verified, as separate components to add to your app. (growth.waitlist.turbineh). Not included: Given a user on the landing page, when they submit the form with a valid name and email, then the signup is recorded in the admin list; Given a new signup is processed, when the database entry is created, then the user's email is automatically added to the Mailchimp audience; Given an admin user accesses the admin dashboard, when they view the signup page, then they can see a list of all registered names and emails; and the application itself (its screens, data and flows) — only these components. This package is not the complete product you described.
